brandStory.mission: HealthSense was built with the pioneering spirit and breakthrough thinking of digital health. We believe everyone deserves a personalized AI solution to track their heart rate and proactively protect their cardiovascular health every day.

story.p1: It all started with a worrying reality: millions of people live with atrial fibrillation (AFib) and arrhythmias that progress completely silently, with no clear symptoms until a stroke occurs.
story.p2: We built HealthSense to close the gap between patients and specialized cardiac care, turning an ordinary smartwatch into a 24/7 ECG lab that is always by your side.
story.p3: Backed by a Stacking Ensemble machine learning model that achieves 98.65% accuracy on standardized medical datasets, HealthSense continuously analyzes 16 heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in real time.
story.p4: We believe your peace of mind is the greatest measure of our success. HealthSense will always be a trusted companion, listening to and protecting every heartbeat on every journey.

features.title: 16 Core Biological Features
features.subtitle: A process that decomposes ECG signals into 3 core biomathematical pillars, helping the AI accurately assess cardiovascular risk.

timeDomain.title: BEAT-TO-BEAT VARIABILITY
timeDomain.subtitle: Time-Domain Analysis (8 metrics)
timeDomain.tagline: Precise measurement of every R-R interval
timeDomain.desc: The AI continuously scans every heartbeat using the Pan-Tompkins peak detection algorithm. RMSSD and pNN50 instantly reflect parasympathetic activity and flag abnormally slow or fast heart rhythms.

tech.hrMean: Mean heart rate within the observation window
tech.meanNn: Mean interval between two normal beats
tech.sdnn: Standard deviation of NN intervals, reflecting cardiac autonomic capacity
tech.rmssd: Root mean square of successive beat-to-beat differences (Gold-standard metric)
tech.nn50: Number of successive beat pairs differing by > 50ms
tech.pnn50: Percentage of successive beat pairs differing by > 50ms

frequencyDomain.title: AUTONOMIC BALANCE
frequencyDomain.subtitle: Frequency-Domain FFT (6 metrics)
frequencyDomain.desc: The RR series is interpolated at 4Hz and analyzed with Welch power spectral density (PSD). The LF/HF ratio reveals the balance between the sympathetic (stress, vasoconstriction) and parasympathetic (relaxation, recovery) nervous systems.

tech.hf: High-frequency band power (parasympathetic & respiratory sinus arrhythmia, RSA)
tech.lfNorm: LF power normalized to total available power
tech.hfNorm: Normalized HF power reflecting vagal activity
tech.totalPower: Total power across the full frequency band

nonlinearDomain.title: AFIB IDENTIFICATION
nonlinearDomain.subtitle: Non-Linear Poincaré & SampEn (3 metrics)
nonlinearDomain.tagline: Detecting chaos and irregularity in the heart
nonlinearDomain.desc: Uses the Poincaré scatter plot (SD1/SD2) and Sample Entropy (SampEn). During atrial fibrillation (AFib), the heart rhythm loses its periodicity and SampEn rises sharply — the key to early detection.

tech.sd1: Poincaré short-axis radius: short-term beat-to-beat variability
tech.sd2: Poincaré long-axis radius: overall long-term variability
tech.sampEn: Sample Entropy measuring rhythm irregularity and chaos (Gold-standard metric)

pipeline.title: How AI Analyzes Your Heart Rhythm
pipeline.intro: The system automatically runs 3 continuous steps to protect and monitor your heart health 24/7.

stage1.title: Cleaning the Heart Signal
stage1.subtitle: Removing noise & detecting true heartbeats
stage1.tagline: Automatically removes motion artifacts from hand movement to keep the most accurate heartbeat
stage1.summary: When you walk, run or move your hands, the signal from a wearable sensor can be distorted by motion, blurring the heartbeat. The system automatically filters out this noise and keeps every heartbeat clear in real time.

bullets.b1: Sensor samples continuously 125 times per second
bullets.b2: Automatically removes motion artifacts and noise while you move
bullets.b4: Precisely measures the interval between consecutive beats

stage2.title: Analyzing 16 Health Metrics
stage2.subtitle: Measuring rhythm regularity & heart health
stage2.tagline: Turns the intervals between heartbeats into 16 in-depth health metrics
stage2.summary: A healthy heart always shows flexible variability. The AI analyzes 16 heart rate variability (HRV) metrics to detect irregular heartbeats, stress or overload early, before you even start to feel tired.

bullets.b1: Measures heart rhythm regularity (fast, slow or intermittent beats)
bullets.b2: Assesses synchronization between heart rate and breathing
bullets.b4: Normalizes all metrics to a standard scale for analysis

stage3.title: Assessment & Alerts
stage3.subtitle: Detecting and providing early warning of atrial fibrillation (AFib)
stage3.tagline: Combines 4 AI models cross-checking each other for accurate, reassuring conclusions
stage3.summary: Instead of relying on a single algorithm, HealthSense combines 4 artificial intelligence models that cross-evaluate the data. As a result, the system identifies atrial fibrillation (AFib) risk with up to 98.65% accuracy and alerts you instantly.

bullets.b1: 4 AI models analyze independently to avoid false conclusions
bullets.b2: Automatically selects the most reliable outcome

benchmark.intro: HealthSense AI does not make random guesses. Every conclusion is based on 5.25 million real-world medical data points and transparently validated against clinical standards.

accuracy.title: Overall Accuracy
accuracy.desc: Out of 100 analyses, the AI distinguishes almost perfectly between healthy people and those at risk of atrial fibrillation (AFib).

recall.title: Sensitivity (No Missed Cases)
recall.desc: Medical safety first: across 8,165 real measurements, the AI missed only 2 cases that needed re-examination.

speed.title: Real-Time Response Speed
speed.desc: Processes data faster than the blink of an eye and sends an emergency alert straight to your watch when your heart shows signs of sudden arrhythmia.

xai.title: How Does the AI Know Your Heart Is Abnormal?
xai.intro: HealthSense AI is not a "black box". The system pinpoints the 3 most important biological markers that determine the result:

rmssd.title: Irregular beat-to-beat intervals (RMSSD)
rmssd.desc: The intervals between heartbeats jump erratically, a classic sign of atrial fibrillation.

sampEn.title: Signal irregularity (SampEn)
sampEn.desc: The ECG trace loses its regular periodicity and chaotic electrical impulses appear.

sd1.title: Instantaneous beat variability (SD1)
sd1.desc: Two consecutive heartbeats change pace abruptly, without time to adapt.

xai.footnote: 100% consistent with the clinical signs taught in medical schools.

chart.title: Contribution of each metric to the AI's conclusion
chart.subtitle: Percentages show the weight the algorithm assigns to each metric during analysis:

sd1.name: Instantaneous beat variability (SD1)
sd1.meaning: Two consecutive heartbeats change pace abruptly

pnn50.name: Beats deviating > 50ms (pNN50)
pnn50.meaning: How often heartbeats deviate beyond the safe threshold

lfHf.name: Sympathetic imbalance (LF/HF)
lfHf.meaning: The autonomic nervous system regulating the heart is overloaded

cv.name: Coefficient of variation (CV)
cv.meaning: Dispersion across the entire beat series
